title: Tire Basics
description: What a tire is made of, the main tire types, and how all-season, all-terrain, touring and performance tires differ.

title: Reading Your Tire
description: Every marking on the sidewall: size, DOT date code, load index, speed rating, UTQG grades, XL, M+S and max pressure.

title: Tread & Wear
description: Tread depth in 32nds and millimeters, the penny and quarter tests, uneven wear patterns, and how many miles tires last.

title: Pressure & TPMS
description: Finding your PSI on the door placard, checking pressure cold, heat and pressure, the TPMS light, sensors and nitrogen.

title: Damage, Flats & Repair
description: Sidewall bubbles, nails and flats, plug vs patch, pothole and curb impacts, and the spare tire in your trunk.

title: Florida Driving & Weather
description: Rain and hydroplaning, heat and tire aging, hurricane-season prep, Florida tire rules and choosing tires for a no-snow climate.

title: Buying Guides
description: When to replace tires, two or four, LT vs P-metric, EV and run-flat tires, trailer tires and buying tires online.

title: Wheels & Fitment
description: Plus sizing, using a different tire size, staggered setups, wheel offset, bolt pattern and center bore.

title: Maintenance & Service
description: Rotation patterns, balancing vs alignment, a monthly-to-yearly checklist, the week after new tires, and noise or vibration.

title: Tire Age, Storage & Records
description: How old is too old, dry rot and sidewall cracks, storing tires in the heat, recalls and tire registration.
